title: KCP project_create request (DESIGN.md §10.1, §11.6.1 space/content mutation family)
description: Mutation (meta required; §11.2: every state-changing operation requires meta). Creates a Project (§10.1). The created project's id is server-derived, so no project_id member exists (gap notes KG5/KG16); default classification and policy set may be supplied at creation only — later changes use the prepared ProjectAccessPolicyChange path (§10.1; gap note KG17). Registry (shared_space_v1): surface external_client / principal (assurance: current login). Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible (gap note KG14 for dual-surface ops).

default_classification_ref.description: Optional at creation only; later changes use project_access_policy_change_prepare/confirm (§10.1; gap note KG17).

policy_set_ref.description: Optional at creation only; later changes use project_access_policy_change_prepare/confirm (§10.1; gap note KG17).

args.description: Caller-suppliable Project fields (§10.1 record shape, names verbatim); project_id, revision, status, created_by, and created_at are server/channel-derived and can never be supplied (gap note KG5).

commandMeta.description: Command.meta (§11.2). Required on every mutation; idempotency keys are scoped by authenticated actor, operation, and realm; expected_revision drives optimistic concurrency (mismatch is stale-revision).

displayName.description: Display name bounded by the §11.8 cap of 256 Unicode scalar values, length-bounded again at admission.

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header value; excluded from the idempotency request digest (§11.2).
